title: Husband says it's too soft, no support. I liked it - easy on my arthritic knee
text:
Husband says it's too soft, no support. I liked it - easy on my arthritic knee. This is one of those products that leads to a hard stop for one person in a marriage. I love this topper - it's soft and definitely helps my bad knee after a painful day. I even like the lavender scent. That lavender is sort of flowing through the entire house actually. My two oldest dogs were very comfortable on this - I suspect the deep foam eased their 14 year old arthritic hips and knees.

My husband on the other hand, has a completely opposite take on it. He was miserable for two nights on the topper. It's so soft that he felt like he was sleeping in a hole. Tossing and turning all night and he never did get comfortable. He also feels like the lavender is way too strong.

After two nights, we pulled it off of our shared bed. We have excellent mattresses on both our bed and the main guest bed so I had to come up with an alternative use for this thing. Since the dogs liked it, I've cut it into pieces and made dog beds. The bed covers are washable so this should work out nicely.
